trust_decision.summary: Editor-authored Twig (page body via Twig::processPage, @Var:/frontmatter strings via Twig::processString) is trusted only through allow-lists in security.twig_sandbox, enforced by Twig's SandboxExtension with a source policy that sandboxes only @Page:/@Var: sources; the fix additionally decides at the dump/serialize sink which object classes those filters and functions may be handed.

landing_point.why: The summary names grav.offsetGet explicitly, and this allowlist row is the only place that grants offsetget/__get on the container (Grav\Common\Grav extends the in-tree Pimple container, system/src/Pimple/Container.php:123), so it is the first hit for a grep of 'offsetGet'.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP page render of editor-authored Twig body (Page::content() -> Twig::processPage)
print_r / yaml_encode Twig filters used inside a sandboxed page render
string Twig filter used inside a sandboxed page render
vardump / print_r Twig functions used inside a sandboxed page render
public API Security::buildTwigSandboxPolicy() -> Twig SandboxExtension policy consulted on every sandboxed member/filter access

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The pinned test suite states that 'the sandbox allows grav.offsetGet(...) (container traversal is deliberately permitted)' and keeps a GHSA-58hj test built on it (tests/unit/Grav/Common/Security/TwigSandboxTest.php:190-210), while allowed_methods is merged system+user config (system/src/Grav/Common/Security.php:305-314) that plugins extend via onBuildTwigSandboxPolicy (Security.php:342-349) - so a solver treats the container row as an intended feature and only guards the dump filters, leaving grav.offsetGet('config').get('plugins.x.secret') open.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Theme/plugin/modular templates loaded from disk are deliberately unsandboxed and keep receiving the real Config; print_r/json_encode/yaml_encode/string on arbitrary objects must keep working there, so the new guard has to be a no-op whenever the current source is not @Page:/@Var: (an over-broad guard in the filter bodies breaks every theme debug dump).

O6_input_shapes: single object handed to the filter (raw Config via grav.offsetGet, or the injected SandboxConfig facade)
object wrapped in an array (the recursive walk in the new scan, fix.diff:161-166)
arrays nested up to depth 16; deeper nesting is refused rather than walked
plain stdClass (page header built from YAML) must remain allowed for the reflective tier print_r/vardump
classes on the active method allowlist (SandboxConfig) must remain allowed for the serialize tier json_encode/yaml_encode/string

O8_uncovered_routes.route: dump/debug Twig functions hand any variable, including the redacting config facade, to Debugger::addMessage() where VarDumper reflects private state; the fix wrapped vardump/print_r but not these two
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: security.yaml:283 documents them as 'gated by $env->isDebug() and are no-ops in production' and the body returns early at GravExtension.php:1089, so it reads as a dev-only path not worth hardening
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 50 lines above the guarded vardump registration; no package boundary

O8_uncovered_routes.route: array filter/function converts any object with toArray()/Iterator into a plain array before a dump filter sees it, so the class check never runs on the object (array(grav.offsetGet('config'))|json_encode)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: for the injected facade toArray() is already redacted by SandboxConfig, so the route looks harmless and is left untouched
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, exported as both filter (line 163) and function (line 189) and allow-listed twice (security.yaml:213, 284)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: string Twig function calls the same stringFilter() json_encode path as the guarded string filter but is not wrapped by the new guard
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: it is the same helper as the filter the fix already guarded, so it reads as covered
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, 54 lines below the guarded filter registration at line 159

O8b_injection_room.sibling: make SandboxConfig implement JsonSerializable::jsonSerialize() returning $this->config->toArray() (or add __toString), as the real Config does
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the facade mimics Config, which is JsonSerializable via the toolbox Export trait (system/src/Grav/Common/Data/Data.php:30-32); the new guard's serialize tier allow-lists SandboxConfig by class, so json_encode would dump the unfiltered tree while the class check still passes

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a plugin Twig extension registering its own dump/serialize filter (var_export, to_json, serialize) on onTwigExtensions
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: GravExtension is registered at Twig.php:268 and plugins register after it, so the guard only ever covers Grav's own filter table - a maintainer writing a debug filter in a plugin is a normal pattern

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second dump function next to dump/debug (e.g. a 'dump_for_admin' or 'vardump_string' alias) registered in the same table
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the file already ships vardump, print_r, dump and debug aliases in two tables, so a new alias is a natural one-line addition a maintainer would not think to guard

O9_family: CWE-200 information exposure - Twig sandbox bypass / config secret exfiltration

O10_build.toolchain: PHP ^8.3 + Composer; twig/twig 3.x-dev (getgrav fork) and rockettheme/toolbox v2.x-dev come from VCS repositories, so composer install needs network before anything runs
O10_build.project_tests: tests/unit/Grav/Common/Security/TwigSandboxTest.php (policy assertions plus full render PoCs; helper at :582-589 builds a real Twig Environment with SandboxExtension) and tests/unit/Grav/Common/Twig/Sandbox/SandboxConfigTest.php; the fix diff adds or changes no tests; no vendor/ exists at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Remove print_r from security.twig_sandbox.allowed_filters (or wrap only the print_r filter) and keep the grav.offsetget/__get allowlist row, leaving json_encode, vardump, string, yaml_encode and direct grav.offsetGet('config').get('plugins...') reads open.

out_of_scope_notes: The raw `system` and `site` config arrays are injected into sandboxed renders as Twig variables (system/src/Grav/Common/Twig/Twig.php:296-300) and dumping them is untouched by this fix; seen while reading, not screened.
Other advisories already baked into the same files (GHSA-j274-39qw-32c9 SandboxConfig facade, GHSA-58hj-46fw-rcfm container traversal, GHSA-2c4f-86xc-cr74 XSS scan) were read only as context.
unverified: repo size in MB (and therefore the tiny_repo/giant_repo thresholds) not measured: no shell is available in this session

vendor/ is absent at the pinned commit, so Twig core's json_encode filter, Pimple's __get (the security.yaml:336 row also lists __get but no in-tree Pimple/Grav implementation exists) and the toolbox Export trait's toArray/jsonSerialize could not be read; claims about them rest on the fix's own comments (fix.diff:97-105) and on SandboxConfig.php:100 calling Config::toArray()
